title: ข้อสอบคัดเลือกค่าย 1 สอวน. ฟิสิกส์ ปี 2565
subject: ฟิสิกส์
level: โอลิมปิก (สอวน.)
note: 30/30 numbered questions have solvers and generators. Scanned source: 25 MC and 5 short answers, no answer key; every answer derived and independently checked. Full transcript remains private; figures are restated as explicit geometry/data.

items.title: หน่วยของค่าคงตัวในเลขชี้กำลัง
items.source: ข้อ 1: หน่วยของค่าคงตัวในเลขชี้กำลัง. MC1: A = B 2^(-(m v^2 / C)) with m in kg and v in m/s. The exponent must be dimensionless, so C carries the units of m v^2: kg m^2 s^-2 = joule (answer 1). Adapted: the exponent holds m^a v^b; returns C's SI exponents (kg, m, s) = (a, b, -b).
items.topic: มิติและหน่วยในเลขชี้กำลัง
items.note: Generalized to m^a v^b in the exponent; answer is the SI unit of C.

items.title: กระแสในแขนงแบตเตอรี่ขนาน
items.source: ข้อ 2: กระแสในแขนงแบตเตอรี่ขนาน. MC2 figure: four branches in parallel between two rails, each R in series with an emf, all facing the same way: E, E (branch through A), E, 2E. The rail voltage is the mean emf 5E/4, so the current through A is |E - 5E/4|/R = E/(4R) (answer 4). Adapted: equal R, any emfs; returns the current in branch `branch` (amps).
items.figure: MC2 figure: four branches in parallel between two rails, each R in series with an emf, all facing the same way: E, E (branch through A), E, 2E. The rail voltage is the mean emf 5E/4, so the current through A is |E - 5E/4|/R = E/(4R) (answer 4). Adapted: equal R, any emfs; returns the current in branch `branch` (amps).

items.note: All emfs face the same way; generator varies the emfs and branch count.

items.source: ข้อ 9: อัตราเร็วของทรงกลมเป้าหลังชนเยื้อง. MC9 figure: equal smooth spheres; B at rest with its lowest point on the line of A's centre, so the centres are offset by b = R. At contact the line of centres makes alpha with u, sin alpha = b/(2R) = 1/2, and B leaves at u cos alpha = (sqrt3/2) u (answer 3). Adapted: offset b, radius R, speed u (m/s).

items.title: รัศมีความโค้งกระจกเว้าที่ภาพตรงวัตถุ
items.source: ข้อ 10: รัศมีความโค้งกระจกเว้าที่ภาพตรงวัตถุ. MC10 figure: object at distance u in front of a diverging lens of focal -|f|; a concave mirror stands D behind the lens; the light returns onto the object. The ray must meet the mirror normally, i.e. head for its centre of curvature, which therefore sits at the lens's virtual image: R = D + u|f|/(u + |f|) (answer 3). cm.

items.source: ข้อ 11: สนามแม่เหล็กจากครึ่งวงกลมสองรัศมี. MC11 figure: picture b joins a half circle of radius R1 and a half circle of radius R2 about O, current circulating the same way in both, by radial leads. B_O = (mu0 I / 4)(1/R1 + 1/R2) = (B R / 2)(1/R1 + 1/R2) with B = mu0 I/(2R) (answer 1). Returns B_O / (mu0 I) in m^-1 for radii in cm.

F cos theta must exceed mu (Mg + F sin theta) for some large F, so cos theta > mu sin theta: theta < arctan(1/mu) (answer 1). Returns tan of the limiting angle.

items.title: อัตราเร็วต่ำสุดที่ลูกธนูผ่านซี่ล้อ
items.source: ข้อ 29: อัตราเร็วต่ำสุดที่ลูกธนูผ่านซี่ล้อ. Short29 figure: wheel with 4 thin spokes turning at omega; an arrow of length l flies perpendicular to the wheel. Entering just after a spoke passes, it has 2 pi/(4 omega) seconds before the next spoke arrives, so v_min = 4 omega l/(2 pi) = 2 omega l/pi. Adapted: n spokes; returns m/s.

items.title: อัตราส่วนคาบลูกตุ้มกรวยต่อลูกตุ้มอย่างง่าย
items.source: ข้อ 30: อัตราส่วนคาบลูกตุ้มกรวยต่อลูกตุ้มอย่างง่าย. Short30 figure: conical pendulum, string l at a fixed angle theta to the vertical. Its period 2 pi sqrt(l cos theta / g) is sqrt(cos theta) times the small-swing simple pendulum's 2 pi sqrt(l/g). Angle given by its cosine.
